Subject: Scheduling Redwood Inference pilot

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight pilot plan (attached) and wanted to propose a 45-minute demo where we: 
- Walk through low-lift integration options (API + embedding sync)
- Run a short live inference on a redacted dataset you provide
- Review expected latency/cost profile and rollout options

Are you available for a demo on any of these windows?
- Mon Aug 24, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue Aug 25, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Wed Aug 26, 09:00–09:45 PT

If those don't work, I'm happy to send a few more options. Attached: Proposed_Pilot_Scope_v3.docx (high level scope + success metrics).

Best,
Jonas

Jonas —

Appreciate the plan and the time. Two quick things on our side: we just locked down Q3 priorities and the payments rewrite + fraud hardening work has been moved to the top of the roadmap. That, plus several key PMs and eng leads traveling through the last two weeks of August, means we need to deprioritize exploratory infra pilots for the near term.

Would you be able to push the demo out? I think it makes sense to revisit in early January (after our planning window). If you can, please send a 1‑page exec summary and a placeholder date range (we'll unblock calendar invites when planning is finalized).

Also attaching our Q3 roadmap export to give context on priorities. Thanks for being flexible.

—Avery
Avery Collins
Head of Product (Payments) | PriTech
avery.collins@pritech.io

Thanks for the update, Avery — totally understandable and congrats on the payments push, that sounds like a major initiative.

We can absolutely push out. Proposed next steps:
- I'll send a 1‑page executive summary and a short cost/latency ballpark today (attached).
- Tentative placeholder: week of 2027-01-11 (I can create a tentative calendar hold for one 45‑min slot and mark it as optional so it doesn't clutter people's schedules).
- If you want, we can scope a narrower technical kickoff so you only need to involve the Payments leads for 20 minutes and the broader infra folks once there is traction.

Let me know which option you prefer. Happy to keep an occasional monthly check-in in the meantime (no slides required).

Best,
Jonas
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
